text.tspan: S7 Jetson power gate and link
SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · preliminary · dashed = part not selected (TBD) · TBR = value not confirmed
Sources: hardware/payload-jetson/POWER_MANAGEMENT.md, INTEGRATION_DESIGN.md; hardware/eps/PDU_DESIGN.md (SW1, INA226); software/rust/firmware/src/gpio.rs (PA2), uart.rs (USART1); W5
Finding F13: while the Jetson is off, the OBC's USART1 TX would back-power the carrier through its
I/O clamp diodes, and an unpowered Jetson RX line would load PA9. Translators with Ioff on both
sides (74LVC1T45: outputs off when either supply is 0 V) isolate the two. JET_3V3 is the carrier's
own 3.3 V on its UART header (TBR); the Orin Nano 40-pin header gives UART1 on pins 8 / 10.
The carrier, its connector and the Jetson's own power-up sequencing are TBD.
